card.name: Pieces inside URLs and DOIs
card.fires_on: Short pieces inside web addresses, DOIs and code-like strings, such as the digits in a DOI, the ?v in a YouTube link, or .com and .ly in a link. It also fires on some code keywords.

modes.label: URL parts
modes.description: Domain endings or query markers inside a pasted web link.

modes.label: DOI digits
modes.description: A digit inside a DOI in a reference citation.

modes.label: Code strings
modes.description: Parts of code or program keys in error text or key shortcuts.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a web link or reference code, where the next piece is a fixed bit of link syntax.
